tagline: Invented encouraging stories about learning and practical ways that will really help you in school, training and studies
description: QULEN tells fictitious, encouraging stories from schoolchildren, trainees and students. Each story ends with a practical part: learning plan, test anxiety, concentration, vocabulary, math gaps, presentations and motivation.
author: QULEN editorial team

lernplan-und-hausaufgaben.name: Study plan & homework
lernplan-und-hausaufgaben.description: Create a learning plan, find a weekly routine, overcome procrastination and do homework without arguments: stories and instructions for a structured everyday learning routine.

pruefungen-und-pruefungsangst.name: Exams & test anxiety
pruefungen-und-pruefungsangst.description: Class tests, exams, Abitur and final exams in training and studies: prepare well, deal with test anxiety and catch a blackout.

konzentration-und-motivation.name: Concentration & motivation
konzentration-und-motivation.description: Distraction through the cell phone, the right place to learn, perseverance after setbacks and mistakes as a learning opportunity: motivation that doesn't sound like a calendar saying.

vokabeln-und-lernmethoden.name: Vocabulary & learning methods
vokabeln-und-lernmethoden.description: Retaining vocabulary permanently, flashcards, spaced repetition, summaries and mind maps: learning methods that support your memory instead of overwhelming it.

mathe-und-lernluecken.name: Math & Learning Gap
mathe-und-lernluecken.description: Finding and closing math gaps, understanding word problems, catching up on the basics and practicing sensibly: how learners get back on solid ground.

referate-und-praesentieren.name: Lectures & Presentations
referate-und-praesentieren.description: Prepare presentations, design slides, speak freely, tame stage fright and participate orally: step by step from a blank page to a confident presentation.
